name: English
title: AI Live & AI Studio — transform your video with your voice
desc: AI Live transforms your livestream in real time, by voice: character, scenery, style. AI Studio edits your videos from a simple description. Price shown before every use.
ogdesc: Your livestream transformed live by AI, with your voice. Your videos edited in one sentence.
lead: AI Live transforms your camera live, using only your voice: become a knight, step into a cyberpunk city, switch styles in one sentence. Back to the real picture in a single tap.
note: Works from a phone or a computer. No graphics card to buy.

mock.aria: Preview: on the left the real picture, on the right the picture transformed by AI after a voice command
mock.say: “Turn me into a knight, castle scenery”

why.h2: The creativity of a studio, the simplicity of a sentence
why.lead: No complicated software, no expensive hardware. You talk, the AI does the rest, and you always know what you pay.
cards: “Stronger”, “add snow”, “anime style”. Commands combine while you film.
The picture is transformed continuously, and the “Original” button brings back your real camera instantly.
Pay as you go. The rate is shown before you start, with no forced subscription and no surprises.

prods.h2: For live streams and for your videos

live.h3: Your stream transformed, in real time
live.p: Your phone or computer camera goes through the AI before reaching your viewers.
li: Characters, scenery and styles in one word or by voice
Back to the real picture in one tap
Stream to YouTube, Twitch, Kick and Facebook, up to 3 at once
Test mode: record yourself without publishing anything

studio.h3: Your videos edited in one sentence
studio.p: Upload a video, describe the change: the AI prepares a quote, then does the work.
li: Change the world, the season or the mood
Edit only a specific part, without paying for the rest
Quote before every job, refunded if it fails

steps: From your phone or computer. Choose the camera, the AI starts.
Say what you want to become. Change your mind anytime, the picture follows.
Do a test, then send the result to your platforms with your stream key, or through OBS.

plat.lead: We start with platforms open to everyone, with no minimum follower count. More will follow.

cards: Change worlds while walking down the street, no PC, no editing.
Original formats for your shorts and videos, in one sentence.
Characters, costumes, moods: something new to surprise your community every stream.

eth.lead: No one can realistically take on the appearance of a real person without their consent. Parodies of public figures are caricatures, always marked with an “AI Parody” banner. Sexual, violent or hateful content is blocked.
eth.p: Your stream keys stay on your device if you choose, and are never shown in clear. In test mode, nothing is published.

items: Do I need a powerful computer?
No. Processing runs on online graphics cards, rented only while you use them. A recent phone is enough.
Pay as you go: per minute for AI Live depending on the chosen mode, per quote for AI Studio. The price is always shown before you start.
Which platforms can I stream to?
YouTube, Twitch, Kick and Facebook to start, up to three at once, or any platform that accepts an RTMP stream (for example via Restream or OBS).
Can I try without publishing anything?
Yes. Test mode shows the transformation on your screen and lets you record tests. Nothing goes online until you start streaming.
Both tools are in private beta and open gradually, by invitation. {link}Join the waitlist{/link} to be notified.
